# FluxSend

> FluxSend is a self-hostable, open-source file sharing platform. It lets you upload,
> store, and share files over signed links with per-file access control and
> S3-compatible storage (S3, MinIO, Google Cloud Storage). It ships as a Docker
> deployment and is MIT licensed.

Key facts:

- Category: secure file transfer / file sharing / self-hosted file storage
- License: MIT (open source)
- Deployment: Docker / docker compose, self-hosted
- Storage backends: S3, MinIO, Google Cloud Storage
- Features: file storage, targeted sharing, quick share links, received files,
  workspaces, API keys for automation, inline file preview, private-by-default
  downloads, usage analytics
- Plans: Free (5 GB), Developer (50 GB), Enterprise (1 TB), Custom — assigned by
  the instance administrator
